description: Urban Water Data - Drought Planning and Management is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. This data package aims to pilot an approach for providing usable data for analyses related to drought planning and management for urban water suppliers--ultimately contributing to improvements in communication around drought. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Water Resources. Its tags are AWSDA, UWMP, california department of water resources, conservation, eAR. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
